release_name: Near me: only a real refusal traps you
notes: Splits the location-failure handling by cause, as requested after review of v27.6.2/3. A real refusal (or no geolocation API at all) is structural - nothing the user can do in the app fixes it, only a trip to Settings will - so those two cases keep the persistent explanation panel. A timeout or a momentary "position unavailable" is usually just a weak signal, and the very next attempt often just works; trapping the user in Near me for that was an over-correction, so those two cases now fall back to normal results exactly as the app always did before v27.6.2, but with the toast that can actually be read (the width and duration fix already shipped). Verified all four reasons independently: denied and unsupported still trap with the panel; timeout and position-unavailable now return to Home with 60 normal results showing and a readable toast, neither one showing the persistent panel.
